other_conditions: The applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
Beneficiary selection is on a first‑come‑first‑served basis among bonafide farmers with sufficient cultivable land.
benefits_summary: Provides quality planting materials, organic manure, bio‑pesticides at subsidised rates, training, and planting, degumming and decorticating machines to eligible farmers.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
